name: The Fortieth Breath
pitch: A headsman who never raises a hand: every blow they do not throw is added to one cut at the last instant of the fight.

new.name: Withheld Hand
new.effect: Your basic attack does not fire. Each time it would, +1.0 c_art to your longest-cooldown art until that art fires.

new.name: Bare Rack
new.effect: +15 points per empty art slot, on arts.
new.second_home: any few-art build, Empty Hand builds

new.name: Whetstone Water
new.effect: +40 points to Sword arts, a coating applied in preparation.

new.name: Measured Stroke
new.effect: Arts with an authored cooldown of 20 s or more cannot be evaded and cannot crit.

new.name: Final Clause
new.effect: Once a fight, if you would go Down, your longest-cooldown art fires in that instant with what it holds.
new.second_home: any build that plans a double knockout

new.name: Still Water
new.effect: Regeneration clipped by a full pool restores health, at half its amount.

new.name: Cut Short
new.effect: +1 heart demon after the fight per whole second art speed removed from the art's reading.

new.name: Last Word
new.effect: One hit, c_art 13.75 plus withheld, cost 0.25, cooldown 40 s, firing at 40.000 at the time limit.

new.name: Standing Verdict
new.effect: Per-hit ward, pass 0.30 body and 0.20 qi, hit_cost_share 0.05.
new.second_home: any build that fears big hits

new.name: Forty-Breath Sentence
new.effect: Main, Thiên giai, Metal. Grants Last Word, Measured Stroke and Final Clause, and seals Standing Post.

new.name: Block-Stone Method
new.effect: Body, Thiên giai. t_b 3 and Still Water.

new.name: Standing Post
new.effect: Theme body refinement, Metal, outer, sealed by a technique, size 10, notables Bare Rack and Withheld Hand as the capability.

questions: Should any keystone be able to switch off the always-on basic attack (Combat rule 13)?
Is a per-hit ward meant to beat a drain ward this badly? The same stats on a common ward die at 31 s to an equal enemy; on Standing Verdict linh lực stays above 90 %.
Is winning a double knockout through Final Clause acceptable, given that NPCs cannot choose to avoid the killing blow?
Should the art cooldown range in Formulas A2 reach 40 s?
